articleTitle: Anonymous Communication Strategy in Telegram: Toward Comparative Analysis of Russia and Belarus
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: This paper aims to study anonymous communication strategy in the Telegram. Telegram is a new cloud-messenger that is highly popular among bloggers and media in Russia and Belarus. Established by Pavel Durov in 2013, it offers secure and anonymous communication features. Anonymous communication has been studied by many scholars (Choudhury, Sharon, Watt, Zhang, etc), but it seems that more questions are left unanswered. This paper starts distinguishing anonymity from related notions of confidentiality and secrecy, privacy, and publicity. We provide some vocabulary to talk about anonymization and identification efforts by message sources and receivers. The paper highlights some of the limitations of current communication scholarship in this area such as anonymous communication strategy. The growing role of the Telegram messenger in the mass communications systems of Russia and Belarus indicates new opportunities for anonymous communication strategy in the digital society. The research methodology is based on a comparative analysis of statistical data on the audience of the leading Telegram news channels. The authors argue that the anonymous communication strategy has taken an important share of the market in both countries. In a comparative aspect, the indicators of the involvement of Telegram channels were analyzed. The main results of the study show that the use of various Telegram features both as a messenger and as a full-fledged media is constantly increasing. The intensity of the use of the messenger has increased and the variety of functions it performs has also increased. It has been established that the Telegram platform contributes to strengthening feedback from the audience. Chatbots have become a new opportunity to receive information from readers. The authors conclude that alternative Telegram channels play an important role in the digital environment.

articleTitle: Communication Strategies of Emotional Engagement on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Recent findings regarding post-truth have led to increasing interest in exploring the role of social media in emotion management. Through communication strategies, media can form various models of emotional engagement of the audience. This paper focuses on the use of the emoticon by both media, all of which have a presence on Vk.com (these include, Lenta, Mayak, Meduza, Novaya Gazeta, Rossiyskaya Gazeta, and Russia Today) and commentators. With the help of a specially written Python script, we record the manifestations of commentators' emotional reactions. Using multidimensional scaling, we explore the particularity of emotional polarization.

articleTitle: Perception and Interpretation of General Humanistic Values Through Communication Technologies in the Digital Transformation of Society
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Modern society faces a global challenge in the field of perception and comprehension of general humanistic values. Digital transformation dictates new technologies for building communications in society, especially this phenomenon has been actualized due to physical and emotional disunity in the context of a pandemic and lockdown. The new content of communication technologies builds public opinion about generally recognized humanistic norms.

articleTitle: The Phenomenon of Tolerance and Non-Violence in the Development of the Individual in the Digital Transformation of Society
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Artificial intelligence, digitalization, cyberspace are an integral part of human life and social life in the 21st century. Technological transformation precedes a worldview transformation, in connection with which there is an ontological need for a new interpretation of the fundamental ethical values of human coexistence in modern reality.

articleTitle: Engaging the Audience of Non-Profit Organizations in Communication in Social Networks in Modern Marketing Practice
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The strategic nature of digital communications is the key to the development of digital society. Digital transformation is not just the introduction of new technologies into the communication process and investments in new technologies, it is an opportunity to transform the product and change its development strategy. Digital transformation is a comprehensive, strategic approach to any area, including communications. Therefore, in the article, the authors are demonstrating on the example of non-profit organizations (including those with an engineering, technical profile) how strategically you can build communication in the digital space, relying not only on digital social media technologies, but also using various marketing mechanisms to engage audiences in communication at various points of contact.

articleTitle: Educational Communication as a Tool to Forming General Cultural Competencies of Students
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Using the example of the implementation of the Digital Exhibition project the article shows the learning process scheme using information technologies [1] and based on a socio-cultural and professionally-oriented environment with the aim of achievement of personhood and professional development of students. (Abstract).

articleTitle: Digital Technologies in Russian Corporate Citizenship Initiatives
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: COVID-19 pandemic forced social structures from business, governmental and nongovernmental sectors to integrate digital technologies to their activities. Lockdown of Spring, 2020 in Russia led to transfer business structures their socially responsible initiatives, interaction with target audiences and stakeholders to digital communication platforms and applications.Digitalization and global initiatives in sustainable development created a new common language to communicate with each other – the global standards for sustainability reporting (GRI Standards). We may observe the transformation of corporate social responsibility approach of business actors to corporate social sustainability one, thus, businesses exhibit themselves as corporate citizens through their communication and activities (Tulchinsky, 2012; Kanaeva, 2014; Blagov, 2015; Kosorukov, 2017, 2019, etc.).The Russian corporations COVID-19 case (X5 Retail Group, United Metallurgical Company, Gazpromneft’, Severstal’, Nornikel) demonstrated that the vision of business organization through corporate citizenship approach and communication strategy supported by active digital communication instruments and platforms development helps to overcome crisis situation for all social partners.

articleTitle: Content Strategy of Medical Services in Digital Environment (by the Eexample of Russian Instagram Bloggers)
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Digital technologies caused information revolution and influenced social practices and institutes, including medicine. Nowadays technological solutions are implemented within medical practices and in the process of their promotion. Mediatization (Mazzoleni, 1999; Schulz, 2004; Hjarvard, 2004; Couldry, 2003; Krotz, 2009; Hepp, 2013) forced medical specialists to enter mediascene to promote themselves and their services.The focus of the article is made on the analysis of content strategy of medical services in digital environment, the role of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies in it. The leading Russian Instagram bloggers in medical sphere serve us the examples.

articleTitle: Communication Strategy of a Community of Non-Profit Organizations and Civic Activists on Social Network Sites: Problems and Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study of specially created non-profit electronic resources (NPO Portals, social network sites) in 18 subjects of the Central Federal District of Russia. The author substantiates the position that the social network sites can be an element of the communication strategy of the nonprofit sector with authorities, citizens, within the NPO sector. The article provides a comparative analysis of the content, the objects of directed communication, the involvement of the non-profit sector in the filling of the social network sites. Suggestions are made on the formation of an optimal model of a non-governmental NPO social network sites as a means of strategic communication.

articleTitle: Digital Literacy as a Factor of Political Communication Strategy in Russia
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: This research is devoted to the digital literacy in Russia. The study focuses on the students since the resent political events in Russia indicate that young people could be mobilized by political campaigning in social media. The article offers the results of a national panel survey of students in higher education institutions and universities (N = 632). As a result of this work, we have received valuable material for describing the phenomenon of digital literacy in Russia and its importance to the political communication.

articleTitle: Digital Media and New Patient-Clinic-Doctor Interaction Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Digital made a dramatic difference in patient-clinic-doctor interaction patterns. The need to visit a doctor makes the patient face a variety of choices. We delude that by employing medical-testimonials portals and other web resources, a patient gets enough information to make a reasonable choice. The research on the biggest medical-testimonials portal in RF and other resources shows that it can't help make a fully informed choice. Research of the largest all-Russian portal of medical services reviews (300pcs.) analyses of 75 Instagram doctors' profiles demonstrate that doctors pressured by the next normal are getting the new professional duty to promote themselves on social media.

articleTitle: Reforms of Peter the Great as a Precedent Phenomenon for Russian Digital Modernization
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The study investigates historical contextualization of digital modernization, which was proclaimed in Russia after 2007 as the main vector of national policy. We studied the applying of the Peter the Great image in Russian mass media as a precedent historical phenomenon. It is relevant not only for traditional media, but also for digital communication, because the most of the central political communities in Russia, in vk.com for example, "are related to the traditional media, which have the maximum communication resources to attract the attention of users" [1]: [73]. Based on a study of 639 media texts published in five major Russian newspapers from 2007 to 2020, we obtain the results, that this image was actualized by the current modernization (together with the images of Stalin and Ivan the Terrible) as "the actual past", to comprehend the socio-political realities of the present. We identify the main topic changes, the tonality transformations, as well as the periodization of the today Russian modernization communication.

articleTitle: Influence of Communication Strategies on the Structure of Political Discussions
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: In recent years, there has been an increasing interest in how people interact on social media. This paper explores the influence of communication strategies for forming a public sphere and an echo chamber on the flow of political discussions on Vk.com. Using conversation analysis, we examine eight virtual communities' communication strategies, representing public institutions, media, political parties, and ideologized groups. Based on the study of 6049 comments, it is concluded that Russian virtual communities are characterized by a high level of disagreement in comments and a tendency to verbal aggression. In terms of its form, commenting has all the characteristics of a discussion. Still, in terms of the quality of the content, it is closer to exchanging text information. This type of communication imposes serious restrictions on developing communication strategies at the level of virtual communities.

articleTitle: Imperatives of the Fast and Slow Worlds in Strategic Communications of the Territory
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the interaction of imperatives and technologies of the "fast" and "slow" worlds in relation to the task of managing strategic communications of cities and regions.Fast worlds create technological platforms for self-organization of distributed cognitive and emotional experience gained by digital stakeholders during interaction with a territory. On the other hand, strategic meaning-making for the formation or revitalization of a place brand continues to be the prerogative of the "slow world". The vectors of "long history", traditional culture, architecture, landscapes, etc. work here. The article discusses the communication trends of territories arising in the zones of interference of fast and slow flows of place marketing.In the article the authors present their vision of the current state of the theory of place branding and image-making, based on the analysis of the works of foreign and Russian researchers (S. Anholt, D. Vizgalov, D. Houghton, A. Stevens, M. Kavaratzis, S. Van Gelder, etc.).The article considers the dialectics of the so-called "fast" and "slow worlds" technologies in the sphere of place branding and shows the main directions of theoretical understanding of the changes taking place in this sphere.An approach to the understanding of territorial stakeholders of both fast and slow worlds is substantiated. In this role are active groups of people who have the potential to be included in the communication on the construction of the place brand. And also an attempt is made to differentiate communications with different groups of audiences in the contemporary context and taking into account current trends.

articleTitle: Multimedia Text as a Communication Tool
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the study of the features of the polycode text as a type of media text in the Internet space. Using the method of comparative analysis, the authors identify the ratio of verbal and non-verbal elements in the text, explore the techniques and methods for creating polycode text, including genre varieties of PR-text, drawings, iconic signs and symbols, photos and video images. The empirical base of the study is based on the texts of the official accounts of the three largest Russian universities: Lomonosov Moscow State University, St. Petersburg State University, Far Eastern Federal University in the social network Instagram. As a result of the study, the authors came to the conclusion that only in the unity of the verbal and non-verbal components a text is the most effective as a communication tool. The advancement of digital technologies contributes to the creation of various types of polycode texts, which have different degrees of impact on the audience, and contribute to building brand communication.

articleTitle: Social Media and the Strategy of Crisis Communication in COVID-19 Pandemic: a Case Study of Komi Republic (Russia)
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: In the article the authors analyze the practice of using social media by the executive authorities of the Komi Republic to communicate with the local population during the onset of the coronavirus pandemic in Russia in spring 2020. The authors highlight the mistakes in communication activity of the Head of the Komi Republic in March 2020 which became an indicator of the fragility of the power structure in the region. Besides, there is the characteristic of a qualitatively different approach to informing the population introduced by the new Acting Head of the Komi Republic since April 2020.

articleTitle: Mechanisms for Creating a Mediatized Image Using the Example of Problem Construct
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article presents an analysis of the mechanisms of formation of mediatized images in the context of a decentralized consideration of the phenomenon of mediatization.The author uses a specific mediatized discussion containing a narrative about corruption. The goal is to draw up an objective idea of the essence of the ongoing communication processes and their transformation under the influence of the development of information and communication technologies.

articleTitle: Mobilization Potential of Political Communications in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is focused on the discursive practices of a political actor in social networks. The authors rely on the works of foreign and national researchers (N. Fairclough, T. A. van Dijk, V. A. Achkasova, G. S. Melnik). The research methodology is based on a combination of the critical discourse analysis and quantitative methods. The empirical base of the study is the texts of G. A. Yavlinsky's publications posted on Facebook during the 2018 election campaign. Expected results are evaluation of the mobilization potential of the texts and detection influencing factors.

articleTitle: Professional Communication in the Context of Society Digitalization: Transformation of Ethical Norms and Corporate Rules
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The authors analyze the ethical problems of communication activities in the new digital socio-cultural environment. The article is based on the works of foreign and domestic researchers. The methodological basis is the analysis of the content of professional and corporate ethical codes, cases related to violations of communication ethics. Expected results: fixing changes and identifying trends in the field of ethical regulation.

articleTitle: Gender Aspect of Political Communication on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: This paper provides insights into the gender similarities and differences that can be observed in digital political communication. Comparative analysis of Twitter accounts of six British political leaders (male and female) exposes the differences in strategies the leaders employ to serve the dual communicative purpose: to provide updates about political performance and to persuade citizens, as potential electors, of the soundness of the current policy.

articleTitle: Creating and Using Educational Computer Resources for Developing the English Language Communication Skills
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper is dedicated to the ways of creating and using educational computer resources for developing the students English-language communication skills. The research compares and evaluates the efficiency of computer resources in mastering some communication aspects by students at different communication stages. The paper also differentiates the English-language material and communication aspects for being developing by means of using computer resources.

articleTitle: Breaking Taboos in the Digital Space as a Communication Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: In the article the content of social media is analyzed from the standpoint of value and communicative approaches for the presence of taboo violations, which are qualified as a socially dangerous communication strategy. Ch. Fershtman's, S. Godin's, Yu. Semenov's works are the theoretical basis of the article. Expected results: identification of the factors of the digital space of social media that contribute to the transformation of communication strategies for gaining personal fame into socially dangerous ones.

articleTitle: IoT Ethic In Scientific Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: IoT is now essential for the resource allocation of organized things and people. Science is one of the social institutions that now need in the Internet of Things technology to develop the interoperability of heterogeneous devices and scientific research services. The system of interactions with IoT technology for professional scientific communities, which have special ethical rules for responding to political, economic, social and cultural challenges of society, deserves special rules. Poor contextual awareness of the scientific community is closely related to the problem of protecting scientific data in IoT networks from bad compatibility and inability to connect to the specified communication channels. The search and analysis of scientific communications by existing IoT services is limited by the design limits of the methodological use of connecting IoT devices. The ethical norms of the scientific community can be seen in IoT technologies as constraints, indicators, characteristics and reinforcements for machine learning and IoT human-machine communications

articleTitle: Mythologizing Time in Internet Memes of the COVID-19 Pandemic Period
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article is devoted to the mythologization of time in Internet memes during the COVID-19 pandemic. The authors consider modern social mythology in the context of the digital humanities. Digitalization of human existence leads to the emergence of digital mythology, which allows us to comprehend the new electronic social reality and influences the formation of worldview. The myths of the digital age are embedded in the tools of social communication, one of which is the Internet meme. The authors define the Internet meme as a part of digital culture and a communication phenomenon that can transmit emotionally colored information and influence its perception. Internet memes contain myth elements that allow communicants to perceive the transmitted information with a high degree of efficiency. Memes make it possible for Internet users to describe the realities of a rapidly changing world, while at the same time comprehending it at a high speed, thanks to the recognition of the myth. Myths about the time have become particularly relevant during the pandemic, as they were associated with the need to adapt to new conditions of existence and accelerate digitalization. Internet memes about the year 2020 demonstrate the features of the mythologization of time in the pandemic period.

articleTitle: The Phenomenon of Network Political Leadership: System of Conversion Communicative Resources into Sociopolitical Capital
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article analyzes the network political leadership, describes the system of communicative capital transformation into the sociopolitical one. Based on contemporary researchers (Karlsson, Astren, Coleman, Volodenkov) and expert interviews, the authors determine the difference between the concepts of influencers, bloggers and network leaders, identify the features of network image and communication tools in the process of transforming the leader's communicative resources into political capital.

articleTitle: A New Digital Landscape and Politicians’ Public Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article under consideration aims at analysing the impact of a digital landscape on the activity of state and regional government leaders. The intertwining of offline and online uninhibited information flows, social networks, open data and other digital landscape elements have changed the social credibility online portrait of statesmen. Employing content and metadata analysis as research tools, the author focuses attention on the changes within political and state people’s social credibility online portraits and evaluates the effectiveness of their public presentations.

articleTitle: Russian and Foreign Postgraduate Students in a Technical University: Problematic Fields of Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: This research continues our study of educational communications in the context of active implementation of digital technologies in Russian higher education. The topic of this report is the evaluation by russian and foreign postgraduate students of online distance learning classes in general education disciplines that are part of the postgraduate curriculum of a Russian technical university. The aim of the study is to catalogue the communicative and content problems identified in the total transition of the postgraduate education process to an online format.

articleTitle: The Commemorative Internet Project as Means of Collective Identity Formation: the Development of an Optimal Content Strategy (on the Example of "The Memory Book of the Komi Republic")
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article summarizes the experience in effective search, selection, organization of scientific expertise and representation of the verbal and visual content of the Internet depository "The Memory Book of the Komi Republic". A description of the structure of a separate account is given, samples of filling in the information fields of the database are substantiated, and practical recommendations are made.

articleTitle: Digital Investor Relations in IT Projects Promotion
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article analyses specific features of investor relations in IT projects promotion. It is necessary to build an efficient investor communication system and to create an image of successful project team and promising development.The empirical base of the study is formed of interviews with successful IT project managers, investor web sites analysis, study of open investor relations manager positions, and personal experience of authors as a consultant of startup.

articleTitle: Network Strategies of a Local Incident Mediatization Agents: Ekaterinburg 2019 Protests Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: In the article the analysis of the communication strategies of network agents is provided. Also, the characteristics of their influence on the dynamics of mediatization of a local incident as an event that touches upon the basic needs, interests and / or values of public groups are identified. As a protest case was chosen a situation concerning the construction of a temple on the place of a city park in Yekaterinburg (2019) in the period from 03/19/2017 till 05/07/2019. The purpose of the study is to identify radical communication strategies and tactics in the social network VKontakte, and to specify types of the calls. The authors identify the generators of radical posts and reveal the degree of radicalism of the published calls based on the speech characteristics and an assessment of the involvement degree of supporters and opponents in the protest discourse. The analysis of their quantitative and qualitative characteristics is carried out. The research methodology consists of identifying communication strategies and tactics of network mobilization through qualitative undirected content analysis of posts and comments on the topic of the analyzed incident.

articleTitle: The Influence of Internet Communications on the Basic Values of a Metropolitan City Resident
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The effectiveness of communication strategies depends on the congruence of public communications with the basic values of the target audience. The values can be defined as the phenomena of social reality and as figurative associations to information stimuli. Communications are built on the mental and linguistic basis of society; it reflects the values that are traditional for this society. In the digital era, basic values in the form of figurative associations are still an integral part of people's public consciousness. Due to the fact that associations are related to social attitudes of people, their assimilation and transmission of the system of values, this poses the question about the extent to which associations were modified under the influence of the digital and media environment. Associations explicate people's collective and individual perceptions that are currently continuing to undergo a modification. This article is based on the material obtained as a result of studying positive events of the residents of Krasnoyarsk. The respondents were offered to name an important positive event and three association words connected to it. The nature of a research method is mediated by the content of public consciousness, which reflects the social experience of people who live in the same territory, but in different conditions and possess differentiated knowledge, habits and interests. In addition, the specificity of the paper is the following: it focuses on the qualitative study of the main groups of words denoting these events. In the course of the study, the authors have come to the conclusion that the digital environment of a metropolitan city influences the worldview of metropolitan city residents and is perceived by them as a communication tool, the space for communication and recreation. The basic life values remain the same: relationships in family and with friends, childbirth, communication with nature and with animals, favourite activities, professional fulfillment, etc.

articleTitle: Media Preferences of Schoolchildren During the COVID-2019 Pandemic and the Impact of Digitalization on their Media Consumption
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The aim of the study is to identify the media preferences of middle and senior schoolchildren in the context of distance learning in 2020 and the impact of digitalization on their media consumption. The objects of the research were the communication channels of this target audience during this period. The empirical base of the study was formed by the results of the conducted quantitative - online survey using a questionnaire and qualitative - in-depth interviews - types of research. The analysis of the results of these studies made it possible to compare the media consumption of schoolchildren before and during this period, to identify and identify trends in the current media consumption of the target audience, to identify the impact of digitalization on the media preferences of adolescents.

articleTitle: Increasing the Level of Internet Trust of Citizens to Public Authorities
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Communication problems that arise on the Internet on various issues (for example, discussion of acute environmental topics - the construction of an incinerator in Kamenka, city-wide topics - snow removal in winter), which are expressed in a lack of understanding of the use by state authorities of modern tools and technologies on the Internet in communications with citizens, public organizations of St. Petersburg. This leads to social discontent, distancing of government bodies and the public from each other, and, as a result, to a drop in the level of confidence in the authorities. In this regard, the results of the study will help reduce the digital divide in the communication of public authorities with citizens and public organizations of St. Petersburg.

articleTitle: Communication Strategy in the Design of a Unified Information and Analytical Space of a University
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article substantiates the need to use a communication strategy in the design of a unified information and analytical space of a university. An algorithm of actions for the communication strategy is described. Using such an algorithm, higher education organizations can quickly provide the necessary information, which can help to shape the opinion about the university and its activities in the minds of the target audience as an important part of the organization's image. The use of a communication strategy is also essential when forecasting specialties and areas of training. It will improve the interaction between the university and employers and will increase applicants' interest in the university. This study considers the development of the digital economy in the Russian Federation.The approbation of the main theoretical provisions of the proposed model and the practical implementation of the solution developed on its basis take place at the structural divisions of the Humanitarian and Pedagogical Academy of Sciences (branch) of V. I. Vernadsky Crimean Federal University in Yalta.

articleTitle: A Study of Advertising Content in Digital Communications: the Experience of Applying Neuromarketing and Traditional Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The active introduction of online communications into the life of a modern person has significantly changed advertising content. The use of digital technologies, interactive systems, virtual assistants, self-advertisement, and motion design provided for more comprehensive research methods, fundamental scientific approaches, collaboration with exact natural sciences in the brand promotion system. Today, web consumer behavior patterns are studied and monitored by a unique system of neural networks. The issues of applying neural technologies in various human activities are becoming particularly relevant and, in a way, getting a new growth stage due to the active extension of artificial intelligence developments. Changes in the communication sphere and its digitalization are also links in this process. Modern researchers are not only interested in artificial intellectual platforms, but also in the possible development of human intelligence, the uniqueness of the mental activity, as well as the technologies that would allow one to see directly the entire activity process, visible responses of the human brain, and its neural connection. State-of-the-art artificial intelligence technologies and specially developed software for digital communications of the source and target groups on the web allow us to compare, correlate the body response to external stimuli with the processes in the neural network. The development of neural networks is the driving force for the communication sphere. Neural networks can analyze and correctly apply the data on target groups in the digital marketing communications system and produce over a thousand "product" solutions, which serve microsegments of target groups in a spot manner, can track the customer journey in all sales channels, and the algorithm will also choose where and when to place a message and how many times it should appear in the customer's field of vision. Neural technologies come to the fore in marketing communications allowing one to identify the true (not filtered by consciousness) responses of a potential consumer to various marketing materials. Tools are needed to analyze a vast base of personal data, the volume of which is constantly growing and should be processed. Due to the digitalization of marketing communications activities, many functions of marketing experts are gradually moving into the function of the software implemented by neural network technologies. The fact that the target product began to be promoted in a more tailored and effective manner is linked with the digitalization of communications, the use of psychophysiological methods implemented in neuromarketing. This research studies digital forms of advertising and consumer responses to advertising-graphic content using a complex of traditional and neuromarketing techniques. The object of research is digital content of telecommunication brands.

articleTitle: Russian Incels Web Community: Thematic and Semantic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The purpose of the article was to study the "incels" (from "involuntary celibate") social group in the Russian-speaking segment of the Internet. In the course of the study, the methodology of mixed-methods analysis, thematic and semantic analysis was used. The results of the analysis show the foundations of Russian incels’ ideology and the distribution of its topics. The results obtained are compared with those of the English-speaking communities, which allows highlighting the features of the group of incels in Russia.

articleTitle: Examining the Historical Development of Techno-Scientific Biomedical Communication in Russia
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article focuses on the shift from traditional to techno-scientific biomedical discourse in health-related media communication. The Russian case should be put in context of successes and failures of governmental policies and campaigns, as well as diverse changes in social life that took place in the last decade. To this end, we developed a method for the reconstruction of the timeline that triggered the ongoing techno-scientific progress in Russia based on the decade-long history of healthcare media reports. The dataset includes news reports collected using health and medicine-related keywords from two prominent Russian newspapers ("Rossiyskaya Gazeta" and "Kommersant", from 2010 to 2019). The method employs text-mining tools including topic modelling (Latent Dirichlet Allocation-based), term statistics and graphs of keyphrase relationships to analyze the dynamics of media communication in healthcare during the study period. The results of the study confirm that before 2015 the coverage of health-associated topics includes criminal incidents and the "modernization" of the state healthcare system. After 2016, we detected the spread of a new discourse related to drugs elabeling, new drugs, networks and databases development.

articleTitle: Pitching as a Communication Technology and Pitch as a Tool for Investor Relations in the Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: One of the modern business communication technologies actively used in Investor Relations is pitching, which is usually defined as a brief presentation of a new project or idea for the purpose of selling or obtaining investment. Pitching can be referred to one of the types of corporate proposals initiated by a business entity to establish business relations with partners, in this case with the investment community. The integral characteristic of all corporate offers including the pitch, coming from the business actor is the concept "profit", while the differential characteristics are based on the characteristics of the source, the audience, the object, the purpose of communication and the function. When pitching, the entrepreneur has to convince potential investors of the financial benefits of the project, the growth of its profitability and the low level of risks when investing (buying shares). The pitch should give clear, unbiased information about the new project, supported by necessary verbal and visual arguments, in a concise, "catchy" form, in order to win investors' positive decision.Nowadays digital communications play ever increasing role in preparation and conducting of pitching sessions, which increase efficiency of pitching through multimedia, interactivity, hypertextuality, convergence of various forms and kinds of content and others. Digital packing of information increases the speed of communication, involving more and more participants who can exchange not only information, but also communicative roles.The purpose of this paper is to consider the specifics of the use of the pitching communicative technology in the practice of Investor Relations and to identify the specifics of pitching as a tool of personal communication between a pitcher and investors in the digital environment.The research was based on randomly selected 45 pitches presented by entrepreneurs in the reality shows "Shark Tank" (USA) and "Dragon's Den" (UK), posted on digital platforms of ABC and BBC TV channels.

articleTitle: Surveillance City. Digital Transformation of Urban Governance in Autocratic Regimes
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: A new sociotechnical governance model "digital autocracy", has appeared and started to spread throughout the world in the recent years. Its appearance became possible by reason of structural transformation of neoliberalism: a formation of platform economy based on digital infrastructure and big data. The emergence of digital autocracies was not a result of the governing class’s initial plan to use the internet politically. This is a constellation of many factors that formed in the process of adaptation of political regimes in a number of countries to external (global economic competition, external political conflicts) and internal (political destabilization) challenges. The article is devoted to studying the place and role of smart cities in the sociotechnical governance model of digital autocracies. The smart city functioning specifics in an institutional landscape of political regimes that use a digital infrastructure as a tool to control society have been analyzed on a number of examples. Separately, the article analyzes problems related to the use of data in urban governance: excessive data extraction and non-transparency of state information systems.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Bloggers' Content Impact and Online Travel Resources on Members of the Digital Society
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Within the concepts of «network public policy», «network local politics» the possibilities of the public in digital society to participate in the formation of territory branding and promotion are studied. Publication presents the results and analysis of empirical data variety revealing the influence of content created by bloggers and participants of online tourist communities, who acts in digital sphere, on the perception of tourist destination potential guests, which are the part of digital economy processes. Several sociological research methods were applied: a pilot survey of the participants of two online tourist communities, in-depth interviews with Instagram bloggers.

articleTitle: Communication Strategies of Provincial Cultural Facilities in Digital Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The paper is devoted to analysis of communication strategies of provincial cultural facilities in digital environment. Having analyzed the peculiarities of contemporary digital communication and interaction with audience during the COVID-19 pandemic as well as the ways and channels of cultural projects’ promotion, the authors come to a conclusion that the traditional communication channels are rapidly becoming inefficient which results in a necessity to search for new contact points in offline environment.

articleTitle: Communicative and Social-Psychological Support of Personalization of Higher Professional Education in the Context of Digital Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The goal of research is to find socio-psychological methods, information technologies and communicative means to build a continuous model of socio-psychological and communicative support of professional education personalization. The goals was achieved in the methodological framework, set by traditions of positive psychology by Martin Seligman, differential psychology by B.M. Teplov, differential diagnosis method by E.A. Klimov, as well as vibraimage technologies for psychological profiling. The following results have been reached: firstly, the system of professional education selection has been elaborated; secondly, all chosen methods are based on information technologies, some of them using a highly sensitive indicator data reception; thirdly, recommendations on communicative support of each developed diagnostic procedures in the field of professional education selection were given.

articleTitle: Convergence of Public Relations Texts in Social Media
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: In the digital environment, there is an increasing trendof convergence, convergence of genetically heterogeneous elements in the structure of a single text. The interactivity of the communication in social media often leads to the creation of multi-genre text phenomena, including the field of Public Relatios. The article is devoted to the identification of prerequisites for the actualization process of the convergence of PR-texts in social media, the analysis of their discursive characteristics, functions and stylistic and linguistic features. Convergent PR-texts allocated in the digital environment. They primarily perform, the function of constructing the optimal communication environment of the basic subject, communicative, image-forming, attractive, recreational functions and have a strong influencing potential as a result of using a multimedia format, a personal type of communication, and an appeal to the emotional sphere of the network user. Convergent texts are based not only on combining elements of different semiotic codes (verbal, visual, auditory), but also on integrating journalistic, advertising, and PR-texts into a single whole, which results in blurring the boundaries between genres, traditionally related to PR-texts. The authors distinguish the main two types of convergent texts in public relations: functionally loaded integrative media texts and genre polymorphic PR texts.

articleTitle: Internet as a Platform for Intersectoral Interaction between Government Officials and Non-Governmental Organizations (on the Example of Yaroslavl Region)
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The development of the Internet stimulates the intensity of interaction between government officials and NGOs. The global network facilitates this interaction, presents new forms and opportunities for it. However, for the very nature of this interaction, the basic characteristics of government officials and NGOs perception of each other and the existing relations among them are important. At the same time, Internet tools can only act as secondary elements in the framework of this interaction. Therefore, this paper aims to identify the nature of the relationship between officials of state authorities of Yaroslavl region and municipalities of the region with NGOs and civil activists, including through Internet tools.Empirical data for the study were collected in January- February 2020 by two surveys: a survey of employees of the Yaroslavl region authorities at the regional and municipal level (a sample of 106 people) and managers and employees of region NGOs (a sample of 72 people). The data allowed to assess the specifics of the perception of each of the parties of the existing relationship (trust, awareness of the activities, the nature of the relationship), as well as the possibilities and results of using Internet tools to implement this interaction.

articleTitle: The Specifics of Advertising and PR in the Organization and Conduct of Online Events
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The article contains the analysis of the use of advertising and PR-technologies in the organization of online events. This study contains a comparative description of online and offline events in the context of communication support based on the results of participant observation, in-depth interviews and expert surveys, document analysis. It examines advertising and PR technologies that have proven their effectiveness in organizing online the Big Business Forum in November 2020.

articleTitle: Direction of Social Capital Accumulation of Electrical Engineering Universities
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: Under the conditions of the economy's digital transformation, electrical engineering specialties are becoming especially important. This leads to increased popularity of universities which train specialists in this sphere and at the same time intensifies the competition between them for the best applicants. The introduction of a distance-learning format amplifies this trend, expands the scope of competition between universities, and brings it from the level of cities and regions to the state, or even international, level. In this context, a university's social capital becomes very important, because one of the most critical factors in choosing an educational institution is its accumulated reputation. The article deals with the main directions of social capital formation and possibilities of its accumulation by educational institutions. Based on the example of the largest universities in Russia that provide training in electroenergetics and electrical engineering, a rating has been compiled for the accumulated publicity capital, which is one of the main indicators of the university's performance and methods of increasing social capital. The features of social capital management in the online and offline environment are considered. Particular attention is paid to the accumulation of social capital in relation to one of the most important groups of university stakeholders - students. The method of constructing psychosemantic spaces in assessing the social capital of the university has been proved effective.

articleTitle: Preface
publicationTitle: 2021 Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (ComSDS)
abstract: The IEEE Russia North West Section, IEEE Russia Section and Saint Petersburg Electrotechnical University "LETI" are pleased to present the Proceedings of the 2021 IEEE Communication Strategies in Digital Society Seminar (2021 ComSDS) held in St. Petersburg, Russia on April, 14, 2021. This Seminar is proudly hosted by Saint Petersburg Electrotechnical University "LETI". The Organising Committee believes and trusts that we have been true to the spirit of collegiality that members of IEEE value whilst also maintaining a high standard as we reviewed papers, provided feedback and now present a strong body of published work in this collection of proceedings. The theme for this seminar was chosen as a mean of bringing together the orientations of Digital Society research and teaching providing a basis for discussion of issues arising across the community in relation to humanitarian aspects and electronic engineering. The aim in these proceedings has been to present high quality work in an accessible medium, for use in the teaching and further research of all people associated with Digital Society studies. To achieve this aim, all abstracts were blind reviewed, and full papers submitted for publication in this journal of proceedings were subjected to a rigorous reviewing process.
